candidates.comment: A BusOrCoach is a Vehicle designed to carry multiple passengers, with coaches being luxury versions for long-distance travel. Also called omnibus, motorcoach, passenger bus, tour bus. Examples: city bus, Greyhound coach, school bus, double-decker bus.

candidates.label: Airline
candidates.comment: An Airline is an Organization that provides air transportation services for passengers. Also called air carrier, air transport company, flight operator. Examples: United Airlines, British Airways, Lufthansa, Southwest Airlines. Distinct from Airport, which is the facility where planes take off and land.

types.embedding_query_text: Profession Examples: family medicine physician, test engineer, doctor.

chosen_type.label: Profession
chosen_type.definition: A type of occupation or career.
chosen_type.justification: No schema.org class fits professions; minting with Intangible as parent.

candidates.label: IndividualPhysician
candidates.comment: An IndividualPhysician is a medical business representing a single medical practitioner. Also called doctor, medical doctor, general practitioner, specialist. Examples: Dr. Jane Smith (a family doctor), Dr. John Doe (a cardiologist), a local pediatrician. Distinct from Physician, which is the general role, and MedicalOrganization, which is a facility.

candidates.label: Physician
candidates.comment: A Physician, as a MedicalBusiness, is an individual doctor or a doctor's office considered as a MedicalOrganization. Also called doctor, medical practitioner, medical doctor. Examples: a general practitioner, a specialist physician, a family doctor's clinic. Distinct from Hospital, which is a larger medical facility.

candidates.label: MedicalTestPanel
candidates.comment: A medical test that is a collection of tests commonly ordered together. Also called test battery, diagnostic panel, group of tests. Examples: "complete blood count (CBC)", "liver function panel", "metabolic panel". Distinct from MedicalTest, which can be a single test.

candidates.label: MedicalTest
candidates.comment: A medical entity representing any medical test, typically performed for diagnostic purposes. Also called diagnostic test, clinical examination, medical screening. Examples: "blood test", "urine test", "MRI scan", "biopsy", "physical exam".

candidates.label: PhysiciansOffice
candidates.comment: A PhysiciansOffice, as a Physician, is a doctor's office or clinic where medical consultations and treatments are provided. Also called doctor's clinic, medical office, medical practice. Examples: a family doctor's practice, a specialist's clinic, an urgent care center. Distinct from Hospital, which offers inpatient care and emergency services.

types.embedding_query_text: MilitaryRank Examples: Coast Guard reserve commander.

chosen_type.label: MilitaryRank
chosen_type.definition: A level of authority in a military organization.
chosen_type.justification: No schema.org class fits military ranks; minting with Intangible as parent.

candidates.label: BoatReservation
candidates.comment: A Reservation for travel on a boat, ship, or other water vessel. Also called ferry booking, cruise reservation, boat charter booking. Examples: "A reservation for the Staten Island Ferry", "A booking for a private yacht charter", "A cruise cabin reservation". Distinct from BoatTrip, which describes the journey itself.

candidates.label: ReserveAction
candidates.comment: ReserveAction is a PlanAction representing the act of reserving a concrete object for a specific time slot or spatial allocation. Also called booking, making a reservation, securing. Examples: reserving a table at a restaurant, booking a hotel room, reserving a meeting room, securing a rental car. Distinct from ScheduleAction, which schedules abstract events rather than concrete objects.

candidates.label: BoatTerminal
candidates.comment: A CivicStructure serving as a station for boats, ships, and other water vessels to dock and embark/disembark passengers or cargo. Also called ferry terminal, cruise port, marina, dock. Examples: "The Seattle Ferry Terminal", "PortMiami cruise terminal", "A local marina office".

candidates.label: ReservationStatusType
candidates.comment: ReservationStatusType is a StatusEnumeration listing enumerated status values for a Reservation. Also called booking status, reservation state. Examples: ReservationConfirmed, ReservationPending, ReservationCancelled, ReservationHold.

candidates.label: DefenceEstablishment
candidates.comment: A government building or civic structure primarily used for military or national defense purposes. Also called Military base, army base, naval base, air force station. Examples: The Pentagon, Fort Bragg, Pearl Harbor Naval Shipyard, Royal Air Force Lakenheath. Distinct from GovernmentBuilding, which is a broader category for any government facility.

types.embedding_query_text: Title Examples: first Italian commander.

chosen_type.label: Title
chosen_type.definition: A name that describes a person's position or role.
chosen_type.justification: No schema.org class fits titles; minting with Intangible as parent.

candidates.label: ITNonprofitType
candidates.comment: ITNonprofitType is a nonprofit type enumeration specifically for non-profit organizations originating from Italy. Also called Italian non-profit category, Italy NPO type, Italian charity classification. Examples: 'ONLUS', 'APS', 'ODV' (specific Italian non-profit legal forms). Distinct from NonprofitType, which is a more general enumeration of non-profit organization types.

candidates.label: BoatTerminal
candidates.comment: A CivicStructure serving as a station for boats, ships, and other water vessels to dock and embark/disembark passengers or cargo. Also called ferry terminal, cruise port, marina, dock. Examples: "The Seattle Ferry Terminal", "PortMiami cruise terminal", "A local marina office".

candidates.label: UserPlusOnes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.

candidates.label: DefenceEstablishment
candidates.comment: A government building or civic structure primarily used for military or national defense purposes. Also called Military base, army base, naval base, air force station. Examples: The Pentagon, Fort Bragg, Pearl Harbor Naval Shipyard, Royal Air Force Lakenheath. Distinct from GovernmentBuilding, which is a broader category for any government facility.

candidates.label: BackgroundNewsArticle
candidates.comment: A NewsArticle that provides historical context, definitions, or detailed explanations on a specific topic. Also called explainer article, backgrounder, FAQ document. Examples: "An explainer on climate change", "A detailed history of the European Union", "FAQ about blockchain technology". Distinct from NewsArticle, which reports on current events.

types.embedding_query_text: Role Examples: backup crew member, crew member.

chosen_type.label: Role
chosen_type.justification: Crew member roles are roles; Role is the exact match.

candidates.label: Role
candidates.comment: Additional information describing a relationship or property, such as a person's function in an organization or a character played in a movie. Also called function, capacity, position, part. Examples: 'actor' role for a person in a film, 'member' role for a player on a sports team, 'author' role for a person on a book.

candidates.label: BoatTerminal
candidates.comment: A CivicStructure serving as a station for boats, ships, and other water vessels to dock and embark/disembark passengers or cargo. Also called ferry terminal, cruise port, marina, dock. Examples: "The Seattle Ferry Terminal", "PortMiami cruise terminal", "A local marina office".

candidates.label: OrganizationRole
candidates.comment: An OrganizationRole, as a Role, describes a specific function or position within an organization. Also called organizational position, corporate role, job title. Examples: CEO, Marketing Manager, Board Member, Volunteer Coordinator. Distinct from Role, which is a broader category for any role.

candidates.label: PerformanceRole
candidates.comment: A PerformanceRole, as a Role, is a role an entity plays in a theatrical performance, such as a movie or TV series. Also called acting role, character role, stage role. Examples: 'actor in a film', 'director of a play', 'musician in a concert'. Distinct from OrganizationRole, which is a role within an organization.

candidates.label: ProgramMembership
candidates.comment: ProgramMembership is an Intangible describing participation in loyalty programs, traveler clubs, or purchase clubs. Also called membership, loyalty program enrollment, club membership. Examples: a frequent flyer membership, a grocery store loyalty card, an AAA membership, a gym membership.

types.embedding_query_text: Procedure Examples: rendezvous and docking procedures, multi-vehicle sequence, highly choreographed operations, rendezvous and docking.

chosen_type.label: Procedure
chosen_type.definition: A series of steps or operations performed to achieve a goal.
chosen_type.justification: No schema.org class fits procedures; minting with Intangible as parent.

candidates.label: SurgicalProcedure
candidates.comment: A medical procedure involving an incision with instruments, performed for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes. Also called surgery, operation, medical incision, surgical intervention. Examples: an appendectomy, a knee replacement surgery, a biopsy, a C-section.

candidates.label: PlanAction
candidates.comment: PlanAction is an OrganizeAction that involves arranging the execution of an event, task, action, reservation, or plan for a future time. Also called scheduling, arranging, pre-arranging. Examples: planning a wedding, scheduling a meeting, arranging a trip itinerary, setting up a project timeline.

candidates.label: ArriveAction
candidates.comment: An ArriveAction is a MoveAction representing the act of an agent reaching a specific destination from a starting location. Also called reach destination, get to, land, pull in. Examples: a plane arriving at the airport, a person reaching home, a package arriving at its delivery point, a train pulling into the station. Distinct from DepartAction, which is the act of leaving a place.

candidates.label: BoatReservation
candidates.comment: A Reservation for travel on a boat, ship, or other water vessel. Also called ferry booking, cruise reservation, boat charter booking. Examples: "A reservation for the Staten Island Ferry", "A booking for a private yacht charter", "A cruise cabin reservation". Distinct from BoatTrip, which describes the journey itself.

candidates.label: ScheduleAction
candidates.comment: The act of planning and allocating future actions, events, or tasks to specific time slots or spatial allocations. Also called planning, arranging, organizing, booking. Examples: scheduling a doctor's appointment, booking a meeting room, planning a project timeline, arranging a delivery. Distinct from ReserveAction, which implies making a reservation for a specific resource or service.

types.embedding_query_text: Symbol Examples: baton, symbolic baton.

chosen_type.label: Symbol
chosen_type.definition: An object or sign that represents something else.
chosen_type.justification: No schema.org class fits symbols; minting with Thing as parent.

candidates.label: DDxElement
candidates.comment: A DDxElement is an alternative, closely-related medical condition considered during differential diagnosis, along with the distinguishing signs. Also called differential diagnosis item, alternative diagnosis, rule-out condition. Examples: Considering "strep throat" as a DDxElement for a patient presenting with a sore throat and fever, alongside "common cold."

candidates.label: UserPlusOnes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.

candidates.label: MedicalConditionStage
candidates.comment: A medical intangible representing a specific stage of a medical condition. Also called disease stage, condition phase, severity level. Examples: "Stage IIIa cancer", "early-stage Alzheimer's", "acute phase of an infection".

candidates.label: SpeakableSpecification
candidates.comment: A specification indicating, typically via CSS selectors or XPath, which sections of a document are particularly suitable for text-to-speech conversion. Also called speakable content definition, text-to-speech markup, voice-friendly section. Examples: a specification highlighting the main article text on a news page, a definition for a recipe's ingredients list.

candidates.label: BookmarkAction
candidates.comment: A BookmarkAction is an OrganizeAction where an agent marks an object for later retrieval or reference. Also called flag action, tag action, label action, mark action. Examples: saving a webpage to favorites, tagging an email, marking a chapter in an e-book.

types.embedding_query_text: Event Examples: launch pad explosion, unpiloted moon landing, orbital flight test, explosion.

chosen_type.label: Event
chosen_type.justification: Launch pad explosion, moon landing, and flight test are events; Event is the exact match.

candidates.label: DeliveryEvent
candidates.comment: An event representing the delivery of an item, typically a product or package. Also called Shipping event, package delivery, consignment event. Examples: A package arriving at its destination, a food delivery being completed, a furniture delivery appointment. Distinct from Order, which is the request for items, not the delivery itself.

candidates.label: BroadcastEvent
candidates.comment: A BroadcastEvent is a PublicationEvent representing an event that is transmitted over the air or online. Also called live broadcast, streamed event, televised event, radio broadcast. Examples: a live news report, a sports game broadcast, a concert livestream.

candidates.label: Event
candidates.comment: An Event is a Thing happening at a specific time and location, such as a concert, lecture, or festival. Also called happening, occurrence, occasion. Examples: A rock concert, a public lecture, a sports match, a community festival.

candidates.label: SportsEvent
candidates.comment: An event involving athletic competition or display. Also called athletic contest, game, match, sporting competition. Examples: a football game, an Olympic event, a marathon race, a tennis tournament.

candidates.label: TheaterEvent
candidates.comment: An event representing a live performance in a theater. Also called stage play, theatrical show, drama performance. Examples: a Broadway musical, a local community play, a Shakespearean tragedy.
